knowledge_points.name: 自我介绍与社交问候
knowledge_points.description: 运用'I'm...'或'My name is...'进行自我介绍，并熟练使用'Hello/Hi', 'Nice to meet you'及其回应。

knowledge_points.name: 身体部位词汇辨识
knowledge_points.description: 掌握eye, mouth, ear, hand, arm等身体部位词汇的听、说、认读。

knowledge_points.name: 祈使句动作指令理解
knowledge_points.description: 听懂并执行'Wave your hand', 'Point to your mouth'等身体动作指令。

knowledge_points.name: 良好友谊行为表达
knowledge_points.description: 理解并表达share, help, listen, smile, play together等描述友谊的动词短语。

knowledge_points.name: 家庭成员称谓
knowledge_points.description: 听、说、认读并拼写grandmother, grandfather, mother, father, sister, brother等成员词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 家庭成员身份询问与介绍
knowledge_points.description: 掌握'This is my...'介绍句型及'Is this/that your...?'一般疑问句的问答。

knowledge_points.name: 字母Ee-Hh的语音与书写
knowledge_points.description: 掌握字母Ee, Ff, Gg, Hh的规范书写及其在单词首位的发音规律。

knowledge_points.name: 宠物与野生动物分类
knowledge_points.description: 辨识dog, cat, rabbit等宠物词汇及panda, tiger, elephant等野生动物词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 拥有物与喜好表达
knowledge_points.description: 运用'Do you have a pet?'询问及使用'I like...'表达对动物的喜好。

knowledge_points.name: 动物特征描述
knowledge_points.description: 使用big, small, tall, fast, cute等形容词描述动物的生理特征。

knowledge_points.name: 字母Ii-Ll的语音与书写
knowledge_points.description: 掌握字母Ii, Jj, Kk, Ll的规范书写及其发音词例（如ill, job, Kim, leg）。

knowledge_points.name: 水果与自然环境词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握apple, banana, orange等水果词汇及air, water, sun等植物生长要素词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 植物保护与行动建议
knowledge_points.description: 运用'We can water the flowers', 'We can plant new trees'等句型表达环保行动。

knowledge_points.name: 字母Mm-Pp的语音与书写
knowledge_points.description: 掌握字母Mm, Nn, Oo, Pp的规范书写及其在单词首位的发音辨析。

knowledge_points.name: 基础颜色词汇辨析
knowledge_points.description: 认读red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple, brown, white, pink等颜色单词。

knowledge_points.name: 颜色询问与逻辑混合
knowledge_points.description: 询问颜色'What colour is it?'并理解颜色混合规律（如Blue and yellow make green）。

knowledge_points.name: 字母Qq-Uu的语音与书写
knowledge_points.description: 掌握字母Qq, Rr, Ss, Tt, Uu的规范书写及其首字母发音规律。

knowledge_points.name: 基数词1-10的认读
knowledge_points.description: 听、说、读、写数字one至ten，并能按顺序排列。

knowledge_points.name: 年龄与数量询问
knowledge_points.description: 运用'How old are you?'及'How many + 复数名词?'进行日常数据查询。

knowledge_points.name: 字母Vv-Zz的语音与书写
knowledge_points.description: 掌握字母Vv, Ww, Xx, Yy, Zz的规范书写及其发音辨析。

knowledge_points.name: 社交礼仪综合应用
knowledge_points.description: 综合复习做客礼仪（knock, share, say hello）及赠送礼物等交际用语。

knowledge_points.name: 26个字母全表回顾
knowledge_points.description: 准确书写并识别A-Z全部26个英文字母的大小写形式。

knowledge_points.name: 综合场景词汇归类
knowledge_points.description: 对全册动物、家庭、颜色、数字、植物等主题词汇进行逻辑归纳与应用。
